integrity: The mathematical proofs and finite rational checks are described separately. Source attributions identify the origin of the W map and invariant-density representation. Finite computations are not used as infinite proofs. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The microscopic theorem is restricted to the original four-branch W family as a downarrow 0. It relies on the exact invariant-density series and weak-* limit of Li et al.; those premises are not claimed as new. The left-edge limits exclude discrete jump locations pointwise, and only local L1 is asserted. The original exact formula makes the derived limits potentially accessible to earlier unpublished work; independent priority review has not been performed.
title: Two-scale condensation and dyadic edge terraces for expanding W maps
